title: Redacted hook payload fixture (daedalus.probe-fixture/1)
description: scripts/probes/fixtures/<host>-<version>/<case>[.<variant>]/<install>/<event>-<n>.json, written only by scripts/probes/redact.py (AC-3). n counts per event; seq is the capture-wide order. payload is the redacted original with its key order kept; ids are stable placeholders within one capture (<SESSION-1>, <AGENT-2>), so equality survives redaction. Stays inside the validator subset of .claude/scripts/validate-profile.py. Validate with: python3 .claude/scripts/validate-profile.py <file> --schema bench/schema/probe-fixture.schema.json

seq.description: 1-based position of this payload in the whole capture.

mode.description: The recorder's answer to this call (record, deny, ...).

path.description: Dotted path inside payload, with [i] for list items.
